nodes.summary: For every real $\varepsilon > 0$ the following holds for all sufficiently large $n$: every simple graph $G$ on the vertex set $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ with more than $n^2/4$ edges contains a triangle $T$ and a set $Y$ of vertices, each adjacent in $G$ to two distinct vertices of $T$, with $|Y| \ge (1/6 - \varepsilon)n$.
nodes.title: Book lower bound for Erdős Problem 1034

nodes.summary: It is not true that for every real $\varepsilon > 0$ and all sufficiently large $n$, every simple graph on the vertex set $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ with more than $n^2/4$ edges contains a triangle $T$ and a set of more than $(1/2 - \varepsilon)n$ vertices, each adjacent to two distinct vertices of $T$.
nodes.title: The Erdős–Faudree triangle conjecture is false

nodes.summary: For every real $\varepsilon > 0$ the following holds for all sufficiently large $n$: every simple graph $G$ on the vertex set $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ with more than $n^2/4$ edges contains a triangle $T$ and a set $Y$ of vertices, each adjacent in $G$ to two distinct vertices of $T$, with $|Y| > (1/2 - \varepsilon)n$.
nodes.title: Erdős–Faudree triangle conjecture

nodes.summary: The proposition that the Erdős–Faudree triangle conjecture fails, that is, that it is not the case that for every real $\varepsilon > 0$ and all sufficiently large $n$, every simple graph $G$ on the vertex set $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ with more than $n^2/4$ edges contains a triangle $T$ and a set $Y$ of vertices, each adjacent in $G$ to two distinct vertices of $T$, with $|Y| > (1/2 - \varepsilon)n$.
nodes.title: Negation of the Erdős–Faudree triangle conjecture

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a simple graph on a vertex type $V$ and let $T$ and $Y$ be finite sets of vertices. The set $Y$ is joined to two vertices of $T$ in $G$ if every vertex $y \in Y$ is adjacent in $G$ to two distinct vertices $u, v \in T$.
nodes.title: Vertices joined to two vertices of a set

nodes.summary: For every real $\varepsilon > 0$ the following holds for all sufficiently large $n$: there is a simple graph $G$ on the vertex set $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ that contains no $K_4$ and has more than $n^2/4$ edges, such that for every triangle $T$ of $G$, every set $Y$ of vertices each adjacent in $G$ to two distinct vertices of $T$ satisfies $|Y| \le (2\sqrt{3} - 3 + \varepsilon)n$.
nodes.title: $K_4$-free upper bound for Erdős Problem 1034

nodes.summary: For every real $\varepsilon > 0$ the following holds for all sufficiently large $n$: there is a simple graph $G$ on the vertex set $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ with more than $n^2/4$ edges such that for every triangle $T$ of $G$, every set $Y$ of vertices each adjacent in $G$ to two distinct vertices of $T$ satisfies $|Y| \le (2 - \sqrt{5/2} + \varepsilon)n$.
nodes.title: Ma–Tang upper bound for Erdős Problem 1034

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
